title: Figaro Assembly (written and pinned forms)
description: The shape of an assembly's document — the agreements composed for one design, one per order, each binding a registered agreement and carrying its own topology, beside the designer's words and the designer's answers. The document has two forms with one shape. WRITTEN: each entry names the written agreement it binds (`agreement`, a file name under `agreements/`) and the entries it follows (`follows`, `agreement-<j>` labels), and `assemblyClauses` are written by clause name, as the files under `assemblies/` do; the reference builder is `assembleAuthored` (sdk/src/projection.ts), which binds each named agreement's hash and lifts `follows` into the topology clause's fill. PINNED: each entry carries the bound agreement's `agreementHash` (the `AgreementRegistry` key) and its own fills by clause key, the topology clause's `{ follows: [...] }` among them; the `assemblyHash` is the merkle root over the agreement leaves (`assemblyHashOf`, sdk/src/assembly.ts), the key `AssemblyRegistry` takes, recomputed by every reader from the fetched bytes. The editorial fields and the designer's answers are excluded from the hash. A conformance test (sdk/tests/documents/schema-conformance.test.ts) keeps this schema and the builder in lockstep over the reference files. The schema is OPEN (additionalProperties allowed): unknown fields are tolerated and ignored by conforming readers.

name.description: The designer's own words, for a reader; never part of the hash.

summary.description: One sentence a stranger reads first; never part of the hash.

description.description: The designer's longer telling; never part of the hash.

faq.description: Questions a designer answers about the assembly, in plain words; never part of the hash.

assemblyClauses.description: The clauses composed once for the whole design (a clause whose `block.design.scope` is `assembly`), keyed as the agreement document keys its clauses, each value the designer's fills.

agreements.description: One entry per order of the design, in commit order. The first is the root, which follows nothing; every other names the entries it follows by label.

agreementLabel.description: The entry's label within the assembly, `agreement-<index>`, the target `follows` names. Not a chain id and not a party: the assembly is party-agnostic.

agreement.description: The written agreement this entry binds: a file name under `agreements/`, without its extension.

follows.description: The entries this order follows; empty or absent on the root.

agreementHash.description: The registered agreement this entry binds: the merkle root over its composed clauses, the `AgreementRegistry` key.

clauses.description: The entry's own fills over the registered agreement, by clause key, merged over the agreement's clauses at checkout (the entry's fill wins for the keys it names): the topology clause's `{ follows: ["agreement-<j>", ...] }`, empty on the root.
